mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, and combined with nalmefene (opioid antagonist) creates risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and unpredictable CNS effects due to altered catecholamine and serotonin metabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, and ensure adequate washout period (14 days) after phenelzine discontinuation before initiating nalmefene.
